result.description: The Lunaris Prism is a fictional desktop display designed for long-form reading, annotation, and low-glare office work. It uses a monochrome e-ink style panel with a gentle front light, making it well suited for document review, coding terminals, and gallery-style text presentation rather than fast-motion media. The 27-inch panel emphasizes comfort and clarity over brightness, with a USB-C input for video and power delivery, adjustable stand, and a focus on ultra-low power operation. It is not intended for gaming or color-critical graphics work.
result.title: Lunaris Prism 27" e-ink Desktop Monitor
result.title_description: 27-inch monochrome e-ink style desktop monitor for reading and office use
